decks.notes: This deck focuses on controlling the game by countering opponent's spells, removing threats, and drawing cards to maintain card advantage. It aims to control the board with board wipes like Supreme Verdict and Solitude, while utilizing Teferi, Time Raveler to bounce threats and protect its own spells. The deck also has card advantage engines like Narset, Parter of Veils and Teferi, Hero of Dominaria, along with Isochron Scepter for repeatable removal. The deck includes a variety of versatile spells to handle different situations and maintain control of the game until it can establish a dominant position.

This deck aims to cheat big creatures like Griselbrand and Atraxa onto the battlefield quickly using Goryo's Vengeance and reanimation spells. The deck utilizes instant speed interaction like Ephemerate, Prismatic Ending, and Solitude to control the game until it can assemble its combo pieces. Otherworldly Gaze and Faithful Mending help filter through the deck to find the necessary cards, while Thoughtseize disrupts the opponent's game plan. The deck also has some unique tech like Fallaji Archaeologist and Psychic Frog to further enhance its combo potential.

This deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly to play powerful lands and creatures, with the goal of assembling the Amulet of Vigor combo to generate explosive turns. The key strategy is to efficiently tutor for key pieces like Primeval Titan and Scapeshift, while utilizing lands like Urza's Saga and Gruul Turf to gain advantage. By combining ramp, land recursion, and powerful creatures, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a quick and efficient win condition.

This deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly to cast powerful threats like Primeval Titan and Cultivator Colossus. The key strategy is to use Amulet of Vigor to untap lands for additional mana and take advantage of the bounce lands to generate more mana. With cards like Scapeshift and Malevolent Rumble, the deck can quickly assemble the necessary pieces for a game-winning combo. The deck is designed to efficiently search for and play its key pieces while disrupting the opponent's game plan.

This deck aims to quickly assemble the Cosmogoyf combo by using Gemstone Mine and Gemstone Caverns for mana acceleration, while disrupting the opponent's hand with Inquisition of Kozilek and Chancellor of the Annex. Devourer of Destiny and Thud provide the main combo pieces, allowing for a quick and explosive win condition. The deck also includes various cards to ensure consistency and protection, such as Serum Powder, Pact of Negation, and Summoner's Pact. It focuses on a fast and efficient combo strategy to overwhelm opponents and secure victory.

This Dimir Control deck focuses on disrupting your opponent's plans with a mix of counter spells, discard spells, and removal. The strategy is to control the game by countering key spells, removing threats from the board, and disrupting your opponent's hand. The deck also includes some card advantage engines and finishers to close out the game once you have taken control. The mana base is built to support the deck's spells while also providing enough colored sources to cast your spells consistently.

The deck focuses on using Eldrazi creatures and ramp spells to quickly cast powerful threats such as Emrakul, the Promised End and Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger. It also utilizes control elements like Disciple of Freyalise and Kozilek's Command to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with large creatures and efficient removal spells, while also generating mana quickly with Eldrazi Temple and Green Sun's Zenith. The combination of ramp and control elements allows the deck to outvalue and outpace opponents in the mid to late game.

The deck focuses on using a variety of small creatures with undying and persist abilities to create an engine that can be abused with sacrifice effects. This allows the player to dig through their deck and find key combo pieces while also maintaining board presence. The toolbox aspect comes into play with the ability to tutor for specific creatures with cards like Green Sun's Zenith. The deck aims to control the board while assembling its combo pieces to win the game.

The deck focuses on quickly filling up the graveyard with creatures like Griselbrand and then using Goryo's Vengeance to bring them back onto the battlefield for a massive advantage. Utilizing cards like Ephemerate and Solitude to protect and interact with key pieces, the goal is to set up a powerful reanimation combo that can quickly overwhelm the opponent. The deck has a mix of disruption and card draw to help ensure the combo goes off smoothly and efficiently. By carefully managing resources and timing, the deck aims to win through explosive graveyard-based plays.

This Mono Black Aggro deck focuses on disruption and early pressure to control the game. It uses discard spells like Inquisition of Kozilek and Thoughtseize to disrupt the opponent's hand, while also utilizing efficient removal spells like Fatal Push to deal with threats. The deck also has powerful threats like Thought-Knot Seer and Emperor of Bones to apply pressure on the opponent and close out the game quickly. With a mix of disruption, aggressive creatures, and powerful synergies, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and secure a quick victory.

The deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly using Eldrazi Temple and Urza's Saga to play powerful Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul, the Promised End. The key strategy is to control the board with cards like Glaring Fleshraker and Malevolent Rumble while building up a massive threat with Basking Broodscale and Blade of the Bloodchief. The deck also utilizes cards like Kozilek's Command and Sowing Mycospawn to disrupt the opponent's game plan and maintain board presence. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm and outvalue the opponent with a combination of powerful creatures and disruptive spells.

This aggressive Hollow One deck focuses on using cards like Burning Inquiry and Faithless Looting to quickly fill the graveyard and cast powerful threats like Hollow One and Vengevine for a fast and relentless assault. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with early creature aggression and quick graveyard recursion while also utilizing cards like Detective's Phoenix and Lightning Bolt for additional reach and removal. The combination of cheap, efficient threats and graveyard synergy makes this deck a formidable force in the Modern format.

This deck focuses on aggressive gameplay with a mix of creature threats and removal spells. By utilizing a diverse mana base and Leyline cards, it aims to efficiently cast powerful creatures like Ragavan, Scion of Draco, and Kroxa while controlling the board with Lightning Bolt and Fatal Push. The inclusion of Stubborn Denial provides protection for key threats, allowing the deck to maintain pressure on the opponent while disrupting their strategy. With a balanced mix of creatures, removal, and protection spells, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and secure a quick victory.

The deck focuses on utilizing the Urza lands to quickly ramp up mana to cast powerful Eldrazi threats and control spells. It also includes a toolbox of artifacts such as Karn, the Great Creator to disrupt opponents' strategies. The deck aims to establish a strong board presence while disrupting and controlling the opponent's game plan with a combination of removal spells and powerful threats like Ugin, the Spirit Dragon and Emrakul, the Promised End. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with big threats and powerful control elements.

The main concept of this UW Control deck is to control the game through counterspells, removal, and card advantage provided by cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Narset, Parter of Veils. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan, while setting up a win condition with cards like Solitude and Wrath of the Skies. The deck also utilizes the Isochron Scepter for additional value by imprinting spells like Orim's Chant. The deck's mana base is optimized for consistent access to all colors and to support the deck's control elements.

The main focus of this Boros Aggro deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with efficient creatures and burn spells. It aims to maintain a fast pace and apply constant pressure on the opponent to win the game before they can stabilize. The deck utilizes aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Guide of Souls, supported by cards like Goblin Bombardment and Ajani, Nacatl Pariah to close out the game. Additionally, it includes disruption tools like Ranger-Captain of Eos and Thraben Charm to disrupt opponent's strategies and maintain its tempo.
